pins.name: AIN1
pins.notes: Pin order varies between boards: match by the printed label. Motor A. PWM on one input, the other LOW

pins.name: NSLEEP
pins.notes: HIGH = driver on. Pulled up on some boards, not on others

pins.name: NFAULT
pins.notes: Open drain, LOW on over-current or over-heat. Needs a pull-up

pins.name: GND
pins.notes: Share it with the motor supply and the ESP32 GND
